p_fetch.text: Six thirty in the morning, in Binh Thanh. Alodi picks up today's orders and flags the ones likely to fail, like this air fryer, paid cash on delivery.

p_slots.text: It asks the buyer to choose a delivery window, with quick replies from the route planner.

p_cutoff.text: There's no reply by eight o'clock, when the route locks. So the route runs as planned.

p_arrive.text: Just after ten, the shipper arrives and calls twice. No answer. On most days, that's where the trail goes cold.

p_choose.text: Instead of typing a note, the shipper taps one button.

a_press.text: From here, the agent takes over, and the shipper moves on to the next stop.

a_chat.text: The buyer gets a message right away, while the missed call is still on their screen.

a_wait60.text: An hour passes with no reply. We've sped up the clock here. Alodi checks that it's within calling hours, and then it calls.

a_answer.text: This time, the screen shows a verified brand name, not a stranger's number.

c_hello.text: Hello Mr. Minh, this is the automated delivery assistant calling about your air fryer. This call is recorded so we get the delivery right. Is that okay?

c_ask.text: Our shipper missed you this morning. Tomorrow we have 8 to 12, or 5 to 8 in the evening. Which works for you?

c_reply.text: Tomorrow after five, please. I'm out until late, so leave it with security in Tower B. Or call my wife, zero nine zero three, two two two, two one four.

c_confirm.text: Confirming: Sunday the first of November, 5 to 8 pm, left with Tower B security, and your wife's number if needed. Is that right?

c_bye.text: Thank you, Mr. Minh. Have a good afternoon.

a_extract.text: The conversation becomes structured data: the time window, the drop-off point and a stand-in receiver, each with a confidence score.

a_apply.text: Every field scores above point eight five, so it's applied automatically. Anything lower would go to a person.

a_nextday.text: The next evening, the order is back on the route, in the window the buyer asked for.

a_deliver.text: The shipper reads the context card, and knows exactly when and where to go.

a_end.text: Delivered on the second attempt. Alodi. Make the second drop land.
